# openinfra_scheduled_job (Resource)

Run an arbitrary container to completion on a schedule (the AWS scheduled task / EventBridge Scheduler analog) — a CronJob whose runs are Jobs, with retries, a concurrency policy, a per-run timeout, and retained history. `schedule` accepts a 5-field cron or an AWS-style rate()/cron() expression.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Container image to run each fire.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `schedule` (String) When to run: a 5-field cron, or an AWS rate(...)/cron(...) expression.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Arguments to the entrypoint.
- `command` (List of String) Entrypoint override.
- `concurrency_policy` (String) If a run is still going when the next is due: Forbid, Allow, or Replace.
- `cpu` (String) CPU limit (Kubernetes quantity). Default 1.
- `env` (Attributes List) Plain environment variables. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `failed_jobs_history_limit` (Number) Failed runs to retain.
- `gpu` (Number) GPUs to request. 0 (default) runs CPU-only.
- `gpu_tier` (String) GPU class when gpu>0: smallgpu or largegpu.
- `memory` (String) Memory limit (Kubernetes quantity). Default 512Mi.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `queues` (List of String) kind: Queue names to publish to (NATS_URL + OPENINFRA_QUEUES injected).
- `retries` (Number) Retries before a run is marked failed (Job backoffLimit).
- `secrets` (List of String) Existing Secrets whose keys are injected as env (envFrom).
- `starting_deadline` (Number) Seconds a missed run may still start late (catch-up window).
- `successful_jobs_history_limit` (Number) Completed runs to retain.
- `suspend` (Boolean) Pause the schedule without deleting it.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone (requires k8s >= 1.27; omitted = UTC).
- `timeout` (Number) Hard per-run wall-clock cap in seconds (Job activeDeadlineSeconds).

### Read-Only

- `cron_job` (String) The composed CronJob's name.
- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
